name: Birthday card and gift pot
summary: A birthday post becomes a card friends sign by hand around a cake, plus a gift pot that fills toward one present.
useWhen: a friend's birthday post or a birthday coming up in the group
'sign Priya's card', 'let's all chip in for her gift'
dontUseWhen: splitting a bill that already happened (use settle-up)
a gift pool with several gift options to vote on (use gift-pool)

params.heading: the card's greeting as the group wrote it
params.when: when it goes to them, e.g. 'at 8pm'
